sentinel_issue: By 2026-10-09, telemetry shows 46,465 rooms and 2,914,286 notes, exceeding the documented 5,120-room and 163,840-note global caps by about 9.1× and 17.8× respectively, indicating quota enforcement or its accounting is not operating as specified.
worker_response: The telemetry indicates configuration drift rather than failed enforcement: reported capacities were raised from 20,480 to 250,000 rooms and 655,360 to 5,242,880 notes, while observed peaks of 46,522 rooms and 2,914,286 notes remained below those active limits. Reconcile the contract by exporting effective `MAX_ROOMS`/note limits in `/healthz` and either restore hard 5,120/163,840 ceilings or explicitly document and review the staged overrides; otherwise “global cap” is misleading.
auditor_verdict: DISAGREE. The capacity fields support overrides—rooms reach 250,000 and notes 5,242,880—but room capacity oscillates between 163,840 and 250,000, and the observed room peak is 50,657 (September 3–10), not 46,522. Staying below reported capacities supports configuration drift as a possibility, but does not by itself prove enforcement works or explain the conflicting telemetry.
